name: L06-2F 报警中心
svgcontent:
<svg width="1920" height="1080" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:svg="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
 <g>
  <title>Layer 1</title>
  <!-- 标题背景 -->
  <rect fill="#1a1a2e" stroke="#16213e" width="1920" height="80" id="svg_header_bg"/>
  <!-- 主标题 -->
  <text data-name="标题" fill="#ff5722" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0" x="20" y="50" id="svg_title" font-size="32" font-family="Arial" text-anchor="start" xml:space="preserve">L06-2F 报警中心</text>
  <!-- 副标题 -->
  <text fill="#ff5722" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0" x="1600" y="50" id="svg_subtitle" font-size="20" font-family="Arial" text-anchor="end" xml:space="preserve">实时报警监控</text>
  <!-- 泄漏报警区 -->
  <rect fill="#2d1f1f" stroke="#ff0000" stroke-width="3" x="20" y="100" width="930" height="300" rx="10" id="svg_leak_panel"/>

   <text stroke-width="0" id="VAL_zone1_leak_txt" fill="#ff0000" stroke="#000000" font-size="24" font-family="Arial" text-anchor="start" xml:space="preserve" x="60" y="225">正常</text>

  </g>

   <text stroke-width="0" id="VAL_zone1_humidity_high_txt" fill="#ff0000" stroke="#000000" font-size="18" font-family="Arial" text-anchor="start" xml:space="preserve" x="160" y="550">正常</text>
  </g>
  <text fill="#ff6666" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="0" x="60" y="585" id="svg_zone1_low_label" font-size="14" font-family="Arial" text-anchor="start" xml:space="preserve">低限报警:</text>

  <!-- 4#区湿度 -->
